title: Grateful Dead Live at Devore Field, Southwestern U on 1985-09-15
lineage: Cassette Master (Nakamichi CR-7A) > Tascam DA-3000 > Samplitude Pro X5 > Flac2496
source: Sennheiser 421 mics > Sony D5 (TDK HX-S90) 33 foot microphone spacing

ai_review.summary: Poor recording quality and an unappealing performance that reviewers liken to meaningless noise
ai_review.review: The sole review is highly critical, describing the audio as nothing more than incoherent noises and dismissing any musical value. No positive aspects of the show or its recording are mentioned, leaving both the sound quality and performance in a negative light.

ai_rating.rationale: Based on a single 0‑star review that complains about the audio and performance, indicating both are unsatisfactory.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewer describes the sound as 'jerk off noises' with no discernible musical content.
